description: Heat4Future estimates renewable district-heat supply using must-run and variable plants, buffer storage and seasonal storage. It produces hourly loads, operating schedules, storage calculations and summary plots. The provider is CC4E, HAW Hamburg, with IGSMiE PAN support. Coverage: The planning horizon is one year at hourly resolution for a user-selected site. Inputs include annual building demand and weather sources. Access: The public GitLab project and README document installation and inputs. External-data retrieval and model execution were not attempted. Licence and cost: The repository lists MIT. Automatic Renewables.ninja data access requires a separate registered token. Limitations: The tool is under heavy development and deliberately simplifies losses and plant efficiency, including constant efficiency across load levels. It is intended for initial estimates. For simulation it supports early screening of heat-supply configurations and storage requirements. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
